title: MVP v2 Sprint V2-3: эмиссия валидаторам (киты + сезонность)
brief: Спринт V2-3 по плану v2: дизайн+реализация детерминированной эмиссии PWM/marks по stake-порогам и сезонному множителю, с сохранением replay/snapshot корректности и без незапланированных изменений межшардовой семантики.

delegations.notes: Карта файлов для V2-3: genesis/chain/block/state/types, snapshot replay логика, риски, slices 0-3, test plan, review focus
Slice 0: design freeze + schema prep. Added V2-3 GenCfg fields with backward defaults, pwmd genesis parser supports schema_version 4/5, reward runtime path remains legacy (policy_ver=1 default).

Verification: preflight_target_debug.ps1 OK (~216 MiB / 4 GiB, removed=no); cargo fmt --check PASS; cargo check -p pwm-core -p pwmd -p pwm-cli PASS; cargo test -p pwmd snapshot 43 PASS ~35s; cargo test -p pwmd genes_ 6 PASS (genesis bundle load, schema unsupported); cargo bench -p pwmd --bench snapshot_load --no-run PASS; cargo test -p pwm-core full 99 PASS ~26s. Gap: no dedicated unit test for schema_version=5 JSON fixture in pwmd (parser accepts 4/5 in code; fixtures are v4). FAIL: cargo test -p pwm-cli gen_build — tests::gen_build_v4_bundle expects schema_version 4 but build emits 5 (stale assertion vs GENESIS_SCHEMA_VERSION). Handoff: PARTIAL until pwm-cli test expectations updated.

Hotfix after pwm-testing PARTIAL: updated genesis-build test to assert GENESIS_SCHEMA_VERSION (schema v5), renamed case to gen_build_schema5_bundle, added note about Slice 0 schema prep, and re-ran focused checks/tests.

retest (post hotfix / dab0f5a lineage): cargo fmt --check PASS; cargo test -p pwm-cli gen_build PASS (3 tests); cargo test -p pwm-cli PASS (145 unit + 3 integration); cargo test -p pwmd genes_ PASS (6 tests). Closes prior PARTIAL gap on gen_build vs schema v5.

Independent review Slice 0: design-freeze vs d34e64a+dab0f5a; GenCfg defaults and pwmd 4/5 loader align; pwm-cli schema const + gen_build_schema5_bundle; Chain::seal reward path unchanged (no policy_ver branch). Verdict approve with nits (V4 naming in pwmd loader, optional v5 fixture later).

Slice 1 runtime emission logic: added policy_ver branching with full legacy fallback for policy_ver=1; v2 path now applies pwm_stake_min and marks_stake_min gates plus deterministic season_coeff_ppm scaling from block/header ts in seal and all replay paths. Added pwm-core unit/regression tests for legacy vs v2 gates/season. Ran fn-name segment check, cargo fmt, cargo test -p pwm-core, cargo check -p pwmd; queued CQDS rebuild_index project_id=5 (duplicate enqueue accepted). One focused code commit: 7d9b6cb.

Slice 1 post-7d9b6cb test gate: preflight_target_debug.ps1 OK (~216 MiB vs 4096 MiB, removed=no); cargo fmt --check PASS; cargo test -p pwm-core 104 PASS ~25s; cargo check -p pwmd PASS; cargo test -p pwmd snapshot 43 PASS ~40s (incl snap_replay_uses_blk_ctx, repair_replay_uses_block_ctx); cargo test -p pwmd genes_ 6 PASS; cargo bench -p pwmd --bench snapshot_load --no-run PASS. Legacy vs v2 determinism smoke: exercised by existing pwm-core tests legacy_keeps_reward_path, policy_v2_gates_with_season, reward_v2_gate_stake_min, marks_v2_gate_stake_min, marks_v2_scale_season_ppm (no prod code changes).

Slice 1 review vs 7d9b6cb + freeze: legacy vs v2 branch, stake gates, season ppm from GenCfg (block_ts unused in season_ppm); pwmd replay paths io/repair/ch_http match seal semantics; hdr.ts for apply_tx_with_ctx; fn-segment check clean on touched paths. Verdict approve with nits (four-way branch duplication, future calendar season). Review bundle commit short: e363684 (see commits[]).

Slice 2 closeout (docs-only): зафиксирована совместимость snapshot/replay wiring для V2-3 policy (io/ch_http/repair + Chain::seal alignment), инварианты determinism/schema v4-v5/legacy/policy_v2 block context, acceptance matrix для pwm-testing и open risks (future calendar season, duplicated branch, old snapshots with different GenCfg).

verif.A4_seal_vs_replay_state_root: No extra standalone replay/root test name in closeout; covered by pwmd snapshot blk_ctx tests (snap_replay_uses_blk_ctx, repair_replay_uses_block_ctx) and validate_snapshot state_root checks on sealed blocks.

Slice 3 review vs c84a40a+b12d322: demo guide aligns with schema v5/legacy defaults/policy_v2 JSON path and reward-case matrix; wire string u128 fields match pwmd genesis parser; AGENTS/.cursorrules match orchestrator delegation (main chat orchestrator, pwm-* subagents, CQDS search).
